subject: Data Engineering
title: Schema Violations
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Schema Violations.

hook.text: An age field contains the value 'thirty-two.' The database expected an integer. The pipeline crashes.

buildup.text: Schema violations happen when data doesn't match the expected types, formats, or constraints.

discovery.text: Common violations: strings in numeric fields, dates in wrong formats, and values outside valid ranges.

twist.text: Schemaless systems like JSON APIs delay the crash. The violation still exists — it just surfaces later.

climax.text: Schema validation at ingestion catches violations immediately, before they pollute downstream data.

punchline.text: Validate the schema at the door, not at the dashboard.

quiz.question: When should schema validation ideally happen?
